record.question: A minimum of _____ variable(s) is/are required to be shared between processes to solve the critical section problem.
record.explanation: The critical section problem needs at least two processes sharing a variable (for example, a lock or turn variable) to coordinate entry, so the minimum is two. The printed page 1 options match the input.
